$comment: Print token source of truth for 'The Art and Science of Headphone Design' by Jamey Warren. The `web` block mirrors the light-theme --mp-* tokens 1:1 (the bridge to the website — do NOT redesign). The `print` block is the filled-in paged layer: trim, mirrored margins, baseline grid, bleed, and CMYK builds. Web and print names stay in lockstep so the book and site never drift. Inline this file's values to :root as --mp-* / --print-* custom properties at book-build time.

sans.license: SIL OFL 1.1 — cleared for print embedding

mono.role: technical chrome — eyebrows, captions, spec blocks, folios, diagram labels

print.$note: CMYK builds as {c,m,y,k} 0-100. Values verified against US Web Coated (SWOP) v2 intent.

margins.$note: mirrored — inside > outside for binding; verso/recto swap inside/outside

baseline.$note: all leading a multiple of the 14pt baseline; headings snap to grid

ink_cmyk.$note: #111827 body ink — a near-black slate; single-channel-dominant so small serif text stays crisp and in register

paper_white_cmyk.$note: #faf8f5 — carried by a warm uncoated paper stock; DO NOT print as a flat tint

accent_cmyk.$note: #ea580c — OUT OF GAMUT in RGB->CMYK (dulls toward brick). Non-text marks only: measured traces, part numbers, difficulty dots, corner ticks, rules.

accent_text_cmyk.$note: #c2410c — the darker text-bearing build (5.2:1). Use for any orange that carries type: links, run-in accents, the accent underline under a heading.

accent_pantone_spot.$note: OPTIONAL second-unit spot to recover the on-screen vividness of #ea580c that 4-color cannot hit. If the press run is CMYK-only, fall back to accent_cmyk.

rich_black_cmyk.$note: the large dark 'Daily Driver' band — a cool rich black so it reads deep, not muddy. Never a flat 100% K on a full bleed.

hairline_cmyk.$note: #e7e5e0 warm hairline — figure borders, table rules, dividers

figure_numbering.$note: Replaces the ~22 duplicate page-local 'Fig. 1' labels; CSS counters reset per chapter (see book.css).

export_profile.color: CMYK only — no RGB or spot beyond the optional PANTONE 165 C; flatten all transparency
export_profile.fonts: embed + subset all three families (cleared under SIL OFL 1.1)
export_profile.bleed: 3mm on full-bleed masters; include crop + registration marks
export_profile.black: body/text ink as the ink_cmyk build; large darks as rich_black_cmyk; overprint thin black rules
export_profile.$note: Total area coverage must not exceed 240%. No ICC-tagged RGB images may survive to the press file.
